user.title: Calorie Tracker
user.description: Optional: paste a MyFitnessPal session cookie to import your foods, meals, recipes and diary history. Open a private browser window and log in to MyFitnessPal, open developer tools → Storage/Application → Cookies, copy the value of `__Secure-next-auth.session-token`, then close the private window without logging out. Do not reuse this cookie anywhere else: MyFitnessPal revokes sessions whose cookie is reused.

reauth_confirm.title: MyFitnessPal session expired
reauth_confirm.description: The MyFitnessPal session ended. Open a private browser window and log in to MyFitnessPal, open developer tools → Storage/Application → Cookies, copy the value of `__Secure-next-auth.session-token`, then close the private window without logging out. Do not reuse this cookie anywhere else: MyFitnessPal revokes sessions whose cookie is reused.

reconfigure.title: Update MyFitnessPal cookie
reconfigure.description: Open a private browser window and log in to MyFitnessPal, open developer tools → Storage/Application → Cookies, copy the value of `__Secure-next-auth.session-token`, then close the private window without logging out. Do not reuse this cookie anywhere else: MyFitnessPal revokes sessions whose cookie is reused.

data.near_percent: Alert when a goal reaches this percent

search_foods.name: Search foods
search_foods.description: Search the food catalog by name or brand; most used first.

get_food.name: Get food
get_food.description: All nutrients, serving sizes and ingredients of one food.

recommend_foods.name: Recommend foods
recommend_foods.description: Suggest registered foods and portions. With calorie/protein/carbohydrate/fat targets: closest match that stays within today's remaining goals. Without targets: options within this meal's share of the remaining goals.

meal.name: Meal
meal.description: breakfast/desayuno, lunch/almuerzo, dinner/cena or snack; sets the share of remaining goals

respect_goals.name: Respect goals
respect_goals.description: Never exceed what's left of today's goals

since.name: Since
since.description: Only foods eaten on or after this date; overrides the saved setting, empty disables it

log_food.name: Log food
log_food.description: Add food to the diary. Use food_id with servings or quantity+unit, or name with nutrients.

name.name: Name
name.description: Name for a food not in the catalog

get_diary.name: Get diary
get_diary.description: Entries and totals for a day, or per-day totals and averages for a range.

save_food.name: Save food
save_food.description: Add or update a custom food.

sync_myfitnesspal.name: Sync MyFitnessPal
sync_myfitnesspal.description: Import foods, meals, recipes and diary foods from MyFitnessPal.

since.name: Since
since.description: Rescan the diary from this date

set_goals.name: Set goals
set_goals.description: Set daily calorie and macro goals. Omitted values keep their goal. Calories are balanced weekly unless calorie_period is day.

calorie_period.name: Calorie period
calorie_period.description: week (default): calories balance across Monday–Sunday; day: strict daily limit

recommend_since.name: Recommend only foods eaten since
recommend_since.description: Recommendations only include foods eaten on or after this date (e.g. since moving); empty removes it
